scope: Univariate original-observation validation audit; no added corruption or SRD; no test use
head_factor_interpretation: TASK-style head changes bias AND max-norm together; this factorial identifies the head-setting bundle, not either individual cause
pair_rule: Use rank 7 only when C6/C7 meets the already recorded structure thresholds; otherwise rank 6. No threshold tuning.
scalar_controls: Constant train-mean retention weight applied to raw histories; Ridge alpha=1, and penalty-matched alpha=s^2; estimate scalar from training weights only
proxy_control: Continue raw proxy training with identical initialization, batches, optimizer, updates and validation checkpoint budget; run for each seed in coarse_current only
primary_endpoint: Independent Ridge validation MAE and RMSE, refit per processed training input with fixed alpha=1
secondary_endpoints: proxy MSE versus equal-budget raw adaptation
checkpoint: Validation proxy MSE for coupled proxy/head; independent Ridge never used for checkpoint selection
constraints: All raw/fixed controls use same new window set
Do not compare current full-window scores directly to old 36/12 subset
No parameter growth with component count; increased component count does increase compute
